{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the data types of the columns
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Check the 'revenue' column for any non-numeric or negative values
revenue_info = sales_df['revenue'].describe()

# Check for any rows where revenue is zero or negative and status is 'completed'
zero_or_negative_revenue_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] <= 0)]
num_zero_or_negative_revenue_completed = len(zero_or_negative_revenue_completed)

# Print the results
dtypes, revenue_info, num_zero_or_negative_revenue_completed"}
